unit_convention: Recipe quantities are batch quantities in grams, millilitres or each. Dry chickpeas, lentils and farro are entered as dry weights. Water is explicitly listed at zero marginal recipe cost because the utility rate has not been allocated; its operational quantity remains controlled.
costing_formula: Per line: effective purchase quantity = recipe quantity / (1 - waste_percent/100); line cost = effective quantity x unit cost; ingredient portion cost = batch cost / yield; total cost = ingredient portion cost + takeaway packaging; net sale = GST-inclusive price / 1.10; COGS percent = total cost / net sale x 100.

portion_size.note: Target plated or packed weight. Verify with cooked yield test.
